description: A script for checking custom linting rules in the Superset frontend codebase, including color usage, icon imports, internationalization, and string translation checks.

methods.name: hasEslintDisable
methods.description: Checks if a node or its parent nodes have an eslint-disable comment for a specific rule.

methods.name: checkNoLiteralColors
methods.description: Traverses AST to find literal color values in strings and template literals, reporting violations.

methods.name: checkNoFaIcons
methods.description: Detects usage of FontAwesome icons via imports or class names, suggesting to use a different icon system.

methods.name: checkI18nTemplates
methods.description: Checks for improper usage of translation functions t() or tn() with template literals.

methods.name: checkUntranslatedStrings
methods.description: Detects untranslated user-facing strings in JSX attributes and text nodes, suggesting wrapping with translation functions.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a file, then runs all linting checks.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to process command-line arguments, determine files to check, and run checks.
